title: Chapter 33 Duan Heng Visits The Deserted City
content:
Chapter 33 Duan Heng Visits The Deserted City

Feeling one of the auras, Gu Chen and his people exclaimed: "It's Senior Huang!"

What kind of opponent could make Huang Shou use such power?

You know, Huang Shou has already broken through to the Unknown Realm.

And just when they were confused, a force suddenly pulled them behind.

The next moment, the sound of fighting suddenly approached.

A powerful force directly surged out.

In an instant, those extra-system forces that had not yet reacted suffered heavy losses.

Among them, there were even two Unknown Realm strongmen.

"Ah! Retreat quickly, retreat quickly!"

"I should have known not to come to this Xuan Gu Galaxy!"

Boom!

In the distance, Gu Chen and others were in doubt.

Everyone looked at each other, and then bowed deeply in the direction of Huangcheng.

"Thank you, Lord City Lord!"

The power just now was done by Lu Daosheng.

At this time, everyone also saw the two fighting figures clearly.

One of the men holding a sword was Huang Shou.

The other one was a middle-aged man, whom they did not recognize.

"General Yunqi, who is that man? He can fight on equal terms with Senior Huang."

"This..."

Yunqi also looked puzzled. He did not recognize this man.

And he had never seen him before.

At this time, a beautiful figure appeared in front of everyone.

Seeing this figure, Yunqi and others were stunned, and immediately said respectfully: "Senior Ouyang, why are you here too?"

In the entire Huangcheng, only a few people knew Ouyang Yanqing, and only a few people of Yunqi's level knew Ouyang Yanqing.

They knew that this was the guest of the city lord, and he had a close relationship with Miss Lu Xue.

More importantly, Ouyang Yanqing was strong and at the same level as Senior Huang.

At this time, Ouyang Yanqing looked at the figure fighting with Huang Shou with a complicated expression.

Looking at Ouyang Yanqing's expression, Gu Chen hesitated and said, "Senior Ouyang, do you recognize that person?"

Ouyang Yanqing nodded.

All of a sudden, everyone stopped talking.

Boom!

At this moment, Ouyang Yanqing suddenly made a move.

And the target was those extragalactic forces who were ready to take the opportunity to escape.

Under the absolute crushing of the causal realm, those forces were left with no one alive, and they didn't even have time to scream.

So far, all these extragalactic forces have fallen in the Xuan Gu Galaxy.

Of course, except for the Eternal Galaxy.

In the distance, feeling Ouyang Yanqing's breath, the strong men of the Eternal Temple in the interstellar fleet were stunned.

The next moment, the huge interstellar fleet bypassed the black hole and came to everyone.

Looking at the interstellar fleet in front of him.

Yunqi looked daunted, but also full of excitement.

Because he also wanted to build such an interstellar fleet.

However, to build such an interstellar fleet, not only resources and strength are needed, but also technology.

Anyway, he didn't have this skill, and he was going to ask the city lord after the war.

At this time, countless strong men in the fleet rushed here.

Seeing this scene, Gu Chen and his people suddenly looked tense.

Twelve unknown realm strong men!

With such a lineup, it seems that the other party is a very powerful galaxy force.

Just when everyone thought there would be a fierce battle, those strong men slowly knelt down in front of Ouyang Yanqing.

"We, meet the Lord God!"

Pah!

In response to them, they were slapped in the face.

Ouyang Yanqing said coldly: "Who asked you to come here?"

At this moment, everyone in the Eternal Temple felt a burning pain on their faces, and no one dared to speak.

The leader stammered, "God, Lord God, I gave the order privately, but I have my own reasons!"

"Oh?"

"Lord God, a world-shaking treasure appeared here. If my Eternal Temple doesn't come, it will be a big loss."

"So, did I wrong you?"

"Uh,"

Pa!

Another heavy slap in the face.

Ouyang Yanqing looked cold, looking at the people in front of him with regret.

"You bunch of idiots! Do you think you are invincible in the universe?"

Everyone in the Eternal Temple knelt on the ground, not daring to breathe.

"With so many legendary treasures, and not hiding them, do you think this is an ordinary force?"

Hearing this, the leader was silent.

He knew all this.

In fact, most of the forces that came here can think of this.

But greed can't really be stopped.

It is obvious that all the forces that came here paid a painful price because of greed.

"Someone come!"

"Lord God!"

Ouyang Yanqing pointed at the head of the Eternal Temple in front of him and said in a cold tone: "Take him back and lock him up in the God Prison. No one is allowed to let him out without my permission."

Hearing this, he immediately collapsed on the ground.

God Prison, that is a place more terrifying than hell.

Once you go in, you will completely lose your future.

"Yes, Lord God."

Before he could react, two powerful men with terrifying auras took him away.

Behind Ouyang Yanqing, Gu Chen and others did not dare to say a word.

I didn't expect that Ouyang Yanqing, who looked so kind on weekdays, had such a side.

Yes, there is no simple character among the powerful people who have reached this level.

And at this time, deep in the black hole.

"Hahaha, I didn't expect that there are strong men like you in the universe that I have never heard of."

The person opposite Huang Shou was Duan Heng, who had just arrived at the Xuan Gu Galaxy.

At this time, Duan Heng was looking at Huang Shou with an admiring look.

For him, Huang Shou was simply a pleasant surprise.

And Huang Shou was equally excited.

He hadn't had such a refreshing battle for a long time.

He really enjoyed this battle.

And he knew that the opponent didn't use his full strength at all.

Duan Heng's words were what he wanted to say.

There are such strong men in the universe.

He had been seeking defeat for endless years, but it turned out that he was just looking at the world from the bottom of a well!

"My name is Duan Heng, from the Eternal Galaxy."

"Huang Shou, from Huangcheng."

At this moment, the two introduced themselves separately.

"Desolate City? Where is this?"

Hearing this, the Desolate Guard laughed, "It's a force I joined. Are you interested in joining my Desolate City? I can introduce you to the City Lord."

Hearing this, Duan Heng was immediately shocked.

I didn't expect that there was a higher existence above the other party.

Duan Heng immediately became interested.

"Okay, then I'll go see the Desolate City you mentioned."

Then the two of them put away their breath and left the black hole.

The next moment, the two appeared in front of Gu Chen and his group.

"Huh? Yan Qing?!"

Seeing Ouyang Yan Qing, Duan Heng was stunned.

"Master."

Ouyang Yan Qing bowed respectfully to Duan Heng.

On the side, everyone in the Eternal Temple also hurriedly said respectfully: "Meetings, Palace Master Duan."

They had just met Duan Heng.

"Yan Qing, I was looking for you. I didn't expect you to come to this Xuan Gu Galaxy."

Duan Heng frowned slightly.

Obviously, he thought Ouyang Yan Qing was also here to steal treasures from the Xuan Gu Galaxy.

Duan Heng felt a little disappointed.

However, Ouyang Yanqing said, "Master, this is the place of a, uh, friend of mine, so I stayed here for a while longer."

"Friend?"

Duan Heng asked in confusion.

At this moment, Duan Heng suddenly remembered what he was going to do.

He was going to stop the infighting between these forces and leave more power for the universe.

"What about those other forces?"

Duan Heng looked around, but saw nothing except the people in front of him and the broken starry sky.

"I killed them all."

"What!"

Ouyang Yanqing said angrily, "They wanted to rob my friend's things and invade my friend's homeland, so I killed them all."

Hearing this, Duan Heng was silent.

At this moment, he seemed to realize something.

This galaxy seems to have a special existence.

Because he has never seen his apprentice make friends.

"Brother Duan, the friend that Miss Ouyang is talking about is my city lord."

Suddenly, Duan Heng understood.

At this moment, he was already very curious about what kind of person the Lord of the Deserted City was.

He could actually make Ouyang Yanqing, whom he had cultivated, into this state.

Duan Heng glanced at everyone present and said calmly: "Then I will go to visit your Lord."

"Please."

Then, the people of the Deserted City took Duan Heng back to the Deserted City in a mighty manner.

The people of the Eternal Temple stayed in the starry sky.
